figs.name: signal-conditioning-block-diagram
figs.alt: signal conditioning block diagram from sensor through amplify, filter, isolate, linearize and convert
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing where signal conditioning sits between sensor, ADC and controller, and its amplify, filter, isolate, linearize and convert stages.
figs.after_h2: Where Does Signal Conditioning Sit in the Instrumentation Chain?
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 470" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Signal conditioning block diagram between sensor and controller</title>
<rect width="800" height="470" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Signal Conditioning in the Measurement Chain</text>
<rect x="20" y="62" width="160" height="72" rx="10" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="100.0" y="92.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Sensor</text>
<text x="100.0" y="115.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">raw mV, Ω, Hz</text>
<rect x="205" y="62" width="220" height="72" rx="10" fill="#0d9488" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="315.0" y="92.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Signal conditioner</text>
<text x="315.0" y="115.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">clean and scaled</text>
<rect x="450" y="62" width="140" height="72" rx="10" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="520.0" y="92.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">ADC</text>
<text x="520.0" y="115.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">if needed</text>
<rect x="615" y="62" width="165" height="72" rx="10" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="697.5" y="92.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Controller</text>
<text x="697.5" y="115.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">PLC, DCS, DAQ</text>
<line x1="180" y1="98" x2="203" y2="98" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="425" y1="98" x2="448" y2="98" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="590" y1="98" x2="613" y2="98" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="205" y1="134" x2="20" y2="195" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/>
<line x1="425" y1="134" x2="780" y2="195" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/>
<rect x="20" y="195" width="760" height="170" rx="14" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="400" y="222" font-size="18" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Inside the signal conditioner</text>
<rect x="35" y="238" width="135" height="106" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="102.5" y="273.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Amplify</text>
<text x="102.5" y="296.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">boost mV</text>
<text x="102.5" y="319.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">to volts</text>
<line x1="170" y1="291" x2="184" y2="291" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="185" y="238" width="135" height="106" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="252.5" y="273.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Filter</text>
<text x="252.5" y="296.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">block motor</text>
<text x="252.5" y="319.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">and VFD noise</text>
<line x1="320" y1="291" x2="334" y2="291" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="335" y="238" width="135" height="106" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="402.5" y="273.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Isolate</text>
<text x="402.5" y="296.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">break ground</text>
<text x="402.5" y="319.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">loops</text>
<line x1="470" y1="291" x2="484" y2="291" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="485" y="238" width="135" height="106" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="552.5" y="273.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Linearize</text>
<text x="552.5" y="296.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">CJC and</text>
<text x="552.5" y="319.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">curve fix</text>
<line x1="620" y1="291" x2="634" y2="291" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="635" y="238" width="135" height="106" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="702.5" y="273.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Convert</text>
<text x="702.5" y="296.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">to 4 to 20 mA</text>
<text x="702.5" y="319.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">or 0 to 10 V</text>
<rect x="60" y="385" width="680" height="68" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="412" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Example: Type K thermocouple, about 41 µV/°C</text>
<text x="400" y="438" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0 to 1000 °C gives about 0 to 41 mV, sent on as 4 to 20 mA</text>
</svg>

figs.name: signal-conditioning-troubleshooting-flowchart
figs.alt: signal conditioning troubleshooting flowchart for noise, offset, drift, stuck and saturated output
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog mapping signal conditioning symptoms such as noise, offset, drift, stuck or saturated output and non linear error to causes and fixes.
figs.after_h2: Common Signal Conditioning Problems and How to Troubleshoot Them
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 575" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Signal conditioning troubleshooting flowchart by symptom</title>
<rect width="800" height="575" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Signal Conditioning Troubleshooting by Symptom</text>
<rect x="20" y="55" width="300" height="44" rx="10" fill="#0d9488" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="170.0" y="83.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Bad reading? Find symptom</text>
<text x="560" y="84" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Likely cause and corrective action</text>
<line x1="32" y1="99" x2="32" y2="521" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="32" y1="146" x2="48" y2="146" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="50" y="115" width="250" height="62" rx="10" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="175.0" y="151.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Noisy or fluctuating</text>
<line x1="300" y1="146" x2="338" y2="146" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="340" y="115" width="440" height="62" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="560.0" y="140.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Cause: weak filter, ground loop, shield</text>
<text x="560.0" y="163.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Fix: ground shield, add low pass filter</text>
<line x1="32" y1="221" x2="48" y2="221" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="50" y="190" width="250" height="62" rx="10" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="175.0" y="226.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Offset from expected</text>
<line x1="300" y1="221" x2="338" y2="221" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="340" y="190" width="440" height="62" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="560.0" y="215.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Cause: wrong zero, span or excitation</text>
<text x="560.0" y="238.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Fix: recalibrate, check excitation volts</text>
<line x1="32" y1="296" x2="48" y2="296" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="50" y="265" width="250" height="62" rx="10" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="175.0" y="301.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Drift over time</text>
<line x1="300" y1="296" x2="338" y2="296" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="340" y="265" width="440" height="62" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="560.0" y="290.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Cause: heat, loose joints, ageing amplifier</text>
<text x="560.0" y="313.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Fix: check ambient, redo terminations</text>
<line x1="32" y1="371" x2="48" y2="371" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="50" y="340" width="250" height="62" rx="10" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="175.0" y="376.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Stuck at 4 mA or 0 V</text>
<line x1="300" y1="371" x2="338" y2="371" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="340" y="340" width="440" height="62" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="560.0" y="365.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Cause: open sensor circuit or bad wiring</text>
<text x="560.0" y="388.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Fix: check continuity, power, polarity</text>
<line x1="32" y1="446" x2="48" y2="446" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="50" y="415" width="250" height="62" rx="10" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="175.0" y="451.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Saturated at 20 mA</text>
<line x1="300" y1="446" x2="338" y2="446" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="340" y="415" width="440" height="62" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="560.0" y="440.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Cause: short or sensor out of range</text>
<text x="560.0" y="463.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Fix: check short, match input range</text>
<line x1="32" y1="521" x2="48" y2="521" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="50" y="490" width="250" height="62" rx="10" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="175.0" y="526.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Non linear error</text>
<line x1="300" y1="521" x2="338" y2="521" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="340" y="490" width="440" height="62" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="560.0" y="515.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Cause: wrong TC or RTD type in firmware</text>
<text x="560.0" y="538.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Fix: set type to match fitted sensor</text>
</svg>

figs.name: signal-conditioning-types-infographic
figs.alt: six types of signal conditioning amplification, filtering, isolation, linearization, conversion and excitation
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog summarising the six types of signal conditioning with key values such as 4 to 20 mA output, 50 Hz notch and 1 mA RTD excitation.
figs.after_h2: Types of Signal Conditioning in Instrumentation
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Six types of signal conditioning with key values</title>
<rect width="800" height="520" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">6 Types of Signal Conditioning</text>
<rect x="25" y="62" width="240" height="190" rx="14" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="59" cy="98" r="20" fill="#0d9488"/>
<text x="59" y="105" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<text x="89" y="105" font-size="20" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Amplification</text>
<text x="145" y="157" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Boosts mV or µV</text>
<text x="145" y="187" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">to 0 to 10 V or</text>
<text x="145" y="217" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">4 to 20 mA</text>
<rect x="280" y="62" width="240" height="190" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="314" cy="98" r="20" fill="#0d9488"/>
<text x="314" y="105" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
<text x="344" y="105" font-size="20" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Filtering</text>
<text x="400" y="157" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Low, high, band pass</text>
<text x="400" y="187" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Notch removes</text>
<text x="400" y="217" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">50 Hz or 60 Hz</text>
<rect x="535" y="62" width="240" height="190" rx="14" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="569" cy="98" r="20" fill="#0d9488"/>
<text x="569" y="105" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
<text x="599" y="105" font-size="20" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Isolation</text>
<text x="655" y="157" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Breaks ground loops</text>
<text x="655" y="187" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Optocoupler or</text>
<text x="655" y="217" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">transformer</text>
<rect x="25" y="272" width="240" height="190" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="59" cy="308" r="20" fill="#0d9488"/>
<text x="59" y="315" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
<text x="89" y="315" font-size="20" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Linearization</text>
<text x="145" y="367" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">TC curve and CJC</text>
<text x="145" y="397" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Callendar Van Dusen</text>
<text x="145" y="427" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Square root for DP</text>
<rect x="280" y="272" width="240" height="190" rx="14" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="314" cy="308" r="20" fill="#0d9488"/>
<text x="314" y="315" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5</text>
<text x="344" y="315" font-size="20" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Conversion</text>
<text x="400" y="367" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">mV or Ω to 4 to 20 mA</text>
<text x="400" y="397" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Frequency to mA</text>
<text x="400" y="427" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">HART to analogue</text>
<rect x="535" y="272" width="240" height="190" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="569" cy="308" r="20" fill="#0d9488"/>
<text x="569" y="315" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">6</text>
<text x="599" y="315" font-size="20" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Excitation</text>
<text x="655" y="367" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">RTD typically 1 mA</text>
<text x="655" y="397" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Bridge 5, 10, 12 V DC</text>
<text x="655" y="427" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">AC for capacitive</text>
<text x="400" y="500" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Active modules can amplify and isolate; passive RC filters cannot amplify.</text>
</svg>
